data.acquisitionSummary: Pay As You Go: $10 or $30 top-up = 90-day validity; $100 = 365-day validity. Rates 5¢ talk & text, 10¢/MB data. AT&T network MVNO.

keep.action: Recharge before the PAYG expiration date to roll eligible balance forward. The $10 and $30 options expire after 90 days; $100 expires after 365 days. A zero balance for 30 consecutive days can cancel the account and number.

data.chinaActivation: US PayGo activation and first-use path only; China-first activation is not verified.
data.payment: US card typically; international card acceptance unverified.
data.wifiCalling: PAYG-specific Wi-Fi Calling support is not currently verified.
data.roamingSms: Current H2O terms restrict International Roaming to eligible Unlimited Talk & Text plans; the PAYG route is not an eligible roaming route and should not be presented as a China roaming/OTP option.
data.holdReason: Current terms exclude PAYG from International Roaming, and PAYG-specific Wi-Fi Calling/China continuity is not verified. Keep as observation/HOLD rather than recommending it for overseas number retention.
data.tariffSummary: $10/90d or $100/365d, 5¢ talk & text, 10¢/MB. PAYG international roaming is not available under current terms.
guideSteps: Directory observation only; PAYG is not eligible for current H2O international roaming.
Re-open only if current PAYG-specific Wi-Fi Calling or overseas continuity evidence materially changes.
